sentences.en: After taking the trophy twice on Dancing with the Stars, Julianne Hough takes another trophy of sorts.

sentences.en: Hough went on to win the trophy a second time in season five with her partner, Indy 500 racer Helio Castroneves.

sentences.en: Hough revealed that she signed with the company after season five of Dancing with the Stars.

sentences.en: As if that weren't enough to measure the success of Hough's album, her single That Song in My Head continues to climb the Hot Country charts.

sentences.en: Hough plans on touring with country music star Brad Paisley on his "Paisley Party Tour" that is set to begin June 11, 2008.
sentences.vi: Hough có kế hoạch đi lưu diễn với ngôi sao nhạc đồng quê Brad Paisley trong ""Paisley Party Tour"" của anh ấy sẽ bắt đầu vào ngày 11 tháng 6 năm 2008.
